_comment: Hand-checked stop positions. A matching stop gets these coordinates with absolute priority over SIGA / GTFS / OSM name matching; its settlement_center warning is dropped. `name` is compared like a stop name (case, accents, punctuation ignored); `lines` (optional) limits the override to those line numbers.

overrides.name: Fôro-Corticeiras-Fontes
overrides.label: HAND-PLACED, NOT VERIFIED: terminus of line 96 (Funchal - Estreito - Fôro/Corticeiras/Fontes), in the hamlet Fontes in the upper part of Jardim da Serra (Câmara de Lobos), on the ER229 / Caminho das Fontes. Position approximate (about 32.700, -16.985, given by the maintainer, not measured); the exact terminus platform is not known - check on site or in the operator's data. OSM also has a neighbourhood Fontes at 32.680, -16.977 and bus stops named Fontes at about -17.019, which were not used

overrides.name: Corticeiras
overrides.label: Corticeiras of line 96 = the junction of the Caminho das Corticeiras below Jardim da Serra (Camara de Lobos), as given by the maintainer - NOT the upper hamlet of the same name NE of Corrida (OSM place=hamlet 32.7089, -16.9739). Coordinates are those of the official SIGA planner stop 'ESTR das Corticeiras' (code 13008); that this is the stop the printed timetable means is the maintainer's reading (name match), not confirmed by the operator

funchalTerminals._comment: Which Funchal terminal a line's Funchal end uses, by operator / sub-network. Applied in build:data after the terminal-only stops are made: the first or last stop of a direction whose name starts with "Funchal" gets the group's position (name stays "Funchal"), so `npm run fetch:routes` routes OSRM from these exact nodes. Lines not listed (6xx / 181 / 502 with SIGA or GTFS positions, 500) are left alone.

walks._comment: Guaranteed walking links between the Funchal terminals (group ids). minutes = the least walking time; build:data raises it to the straight-line distance / 70 m per minute, so two terminals far apart are never closer in the planner than on foot.
